name: Curve progress acceleration
hypothesis: Buy after curve progress accelerates while buyer breadth and sell depth both meet thresholds.
spec: Setup: Increasing real quote accumulation can signal approaching broader price discovery. Entry: Buy after curve progress accelerates while buyer breadth and sell depth both meet thresholds. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on progress reversal, concentration breach, or the predeclared migration cutoff. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
